verdict.rationale: Together's first-party docs cover the whole story. Function/tool calling returns structured function names and arguments, multi-step calling chains sequential calls within one turn, multi-turn calling threads tools across turns for agent loops, and parallel calling issues the same function several times at once. Schema-conforming structured outputs add to this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that tool calling is faithful and does not break in agent loops, and documentation of which open models reliably support parallel or multi-step calls.
